mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 51 degrees under overcast skies near the high school, with a waxing gibbous moon lighting up the sky.

Starting September 28, contractors will begin road crack filling across several city areas, including South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street; please use caution in these work zones. Also, the Plan Commission is set to review various development projects on October 5.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory happening tomorrow.
In a notable weekly incident, on September 5, an officer investigated a viral prank where vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields across several streets.
The Verona location is currently closed for a remodel but will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
